consent.title: Discover the cuts that suit you best
consent.message: We'll analyze your face on your phone to suggest cuts. The photo is never uploaded or stored: we only send a few measurements.
consent.p1Title: It all happens on your phone
consent.p1: We measure your face right here; the photo is never uploaded.
consent.p2: Photos are deleted right away. We only send a few measurements.
consent.p3: With real photos and barbers near you.

scan.title: Take a selfie
scan.tip1: Facing the camera, without sunglasses or a cap.
scan.tip2: In good light and with your hair off your forehead, if you can.
scan.tip3: Only your face in the photo, filling a good part of the screen.
scan.unavailable: Face analysis will arrive with the next version of the app.
scan.denied: We need the camera to analyze your face. Turn it on in your phone settings.
scan.noFace: We couldn't see your face well. Try facing the camera, with more light.
scan.progress: {{done}} of {{total}} photos: we take several to measure accurately.
scan.notFrontal: Look straight at the camera, without turning or tilting your head.
scan.tooFar: Come a bit closer: your face should fill more of the photo.
scan.manyFaces: There's more than one face in the photo. Take it alone.

prefs.title: Anything else we should know?
prefs.optional: Everything is optional; it helps refine the suggestions.
prefs.location: We'll use your location only to show photos and barbers nearby. It isn't stored.

result.rememberConsent: I agree that Charles remembers my face shape to suggest cuts (I can delete it anytime).

certainty.LOW: Your face has traits of both: the suggestions work for either
